Technical SEO.title: Rank Math WordPress Plugin Accused Of Secretly Taking Admin Access
Technical SEO.summary: Allegations have surfaced that the Rank Math WordPress plugin silently grants the company administrator-level permissions over WordPress sites when a user connected to a free Rank Math account opens the Help and Support section. The developer of The SEO Framework surfaced the claims, noting there is allegedly zero consent or notification given to site owners.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Claude Searches Web Differently From Claude Code, Data Shows
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: New data reveals that Claude and Claude Code search the web at different rates, mention different brands, and direct their agents to different types of pages. The findings have direct implications for brands optimising visibility across AI agent surfaces.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Facebook Groups Are Google's No. 2 Forum Source
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Ahrefs data shows public Facebook Group posts appear in 38% of Google's Discussions and Forums results, placing Facebook second behind Reddit and ahead of Quora. Enterprise content strategists targeting forum-style SERP features should factor Facebook Groups into their distribution planning.

AI Search / GEO.title: Israel Is Running a Synthetic Think Tank to Influence AI Search Results
AI Search / GEO.summary: A report from 404 Media describes an operation using a synthetic think tank specifically designed to shape what AI search systems surface, highlighting that AI answer surfaces are already being targeted by coordinated influence efforts. This has direct implications for GEO practitioners assessing the integrity and competitive landscape of AI citations.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google's New AI Search Guide Calls AEO And GEO 'Still SEO'
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google's own AI search guidance frames Answer Engine Optimisation and Generative Engine Optimisation as extensions of traditional SEO rather than separate disciplines. This is a meaningful signal from Google for enterprise teams deciding how to allocate resources between conventional SEO and GEO programmes.

AI Search / GEO.title: Introducing Search Generative AI Performance Reports in Search Console
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google Search Central announced generative AI performance reports in Search Console, giving site owners measurable data on their visibility within AI-powered search surfaces for the first time. This is a primary source announcement directly actionable for enterprise SEO teams tracking AI Overview and AI Mode impression data.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google's Generated Interfaces Could Compete With Tool Pages
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google is developing generated interfaces that could directly compete with publisher and brand tool pages in search results. Enterprise teams managing high-value utility pages, including travel planning and automotive configurator tools, should monitor this development as a potential traffic displacement risk.

AI Search / GEO.title: We Tested How AI Chatbots Would Handle Foreign Propaganda
AI Search / GEO.summary: NPR tested how major AI chatbots respond to and surface foreign propaganda content, revealing structural vulnerabilities in how AI search systems evaluate source credibility. The findings are relevant for GEO strategists thinking about content authority signals that influence AI citation decisions.
